resources.string: Keep only the latest generated packs
Keep only the latest generated Apple and Perfect Icons packs.
Apple and Perfect Icons each keep their latest generated version. Older versions are removed after a new pack is saved successfully. Manually imported icon packs are kept.

Keeping only the latest generated packs is enabled by default. Apple and Perfect Icons each keep their own latest generated version; older versions are removed after a new pack is saved successfully. To keep generated pack history, turn this off in Icon packs > More settings. Manually imported icon packs are kept.
